headline: Trump signs AI 'Super Intelligence' order and tech safety accord
summary: Trump signed an executive order directing the US government to call AI 'Super Intelligence,' and tech executives signed a voluntary safety accord, the Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities, which the White House misspelled 'United States' on. Outlets disagree on how many executives attended: the Guardian reports six, while TechCrunch describes nearly every major tech CEO. Coverage also splits on the accord's value, from skeptical to approving.
